pin.title: R33 towards Msinga, Greytown (map point approximate): station commander shot dead and two suspects killed in shootout after supermarket robbery, 12 Nov
pin.location_note: APPROXIMATE MAP POINT. R33 towards Msinga, after a robbery at Lucky Supermarket, Greytown CBD. The exact place on the R33 is not given; the pin is the Greytown town point (-29.0606, 30.5889). About 5 km.

note: Research only. Nothing here is published until a record in docs/signals/location-photos.json is approved by the owner.
